# Research is more than just publications---you are worth more than your publications

::: content-hidden
Share your career path and your experience and tools for data management and reproducibility

- Time is 1 hour, with 30 minute presentation and 20 minute Q&A
- The title is maximum 15 words
- Brief paragraph is maximum 150 words
:::

If you spend any time in research, you will be familiar with the pressure to
publish and the saying "publish or perish". This pressure has many negative
consequences, including the tendency for researchers to hyperfocus on
publications as the primary measure of their success and career progression. But
there is so much more to research! In this talk, I will share my career path as
a team leader on research software project, which largely came about because of
my desire to improve reproducibility and the management and care of research
data.
